title: The Wearables & Health Data Manual
subtitle: Kind setup, honest numbers, and safe sharing for watches, rings, and health apps
author: Dylan Asdale
description: An education-only manual for smartwatches, smart rings, and health apps: setting a watch up kindly, what heart-rate and sleep numbers honestly mean, exporting your data safely, sharing trends with your own care team, family sharing and kids' accounts, privacy settings worth touching, battery habits, and a gentle monthly data ritual. Never medical advice, no hype, works offline.
